## Download

Pick the file for your computer from **Assets** below:

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1–M4) | `…-macos-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `…-macos-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `…-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Linux (64-bit) | `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (or `.tar.gz`) |
| Chrome extension (optional) | `…-chrome-extension.zip` |

**First launch:** these builds aren't code-signed yet.
- **macOS:** right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**.
- **Windows:** on the SmartScreen warning, click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** run `chmod +x` on the AppImage, then start it.

The full install guide, including Chrome extension setup, is in
[docs/INSTALL.md](https://github.com/SithumRaigamage/flowdownload/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md).
To check a download, use `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
